rules.language: Carousels ENGLISH · Reels MARATHI (Devanagari) · Hinglish where relational. Never romanised Hinglish for reference posts.
rules.framing: Relational beats transactional 78 vs 23 at the median. At least one genuinely relational post per week.
rules.format: Your carousels win (266x/247x/120x). Your reels lose (1.00x/0.47x/0.42x). 3 carousels + 1 reel until the Marathi reel proves otherwise.
rules.reality: Account dormant 417 days (7 Aug 2025 → 29 Sep 2026). Median fell 13,099 → 36. That is cold-start, not a penalty. Expect 50–150 on a good post. Consistency is the cure, 3–6 weeks.
